note: Findings collected during the UNI-235 category audit that are NOT categorisation problems and are deliberately not fixed here. pattern_suspect belongs to UNI-237 (detection precision); name_overclaims belongs to UNI-238 (vocabulary and naming).

pattern_suspect.name: PWA
pattern_suspect.reason: Progressive Web App capability, not an OS. Pattern (manifest) fires too broadly (17.5%).

pattern_suspect.name: Ghost
pattern_suspect.reason: Pattern includes bare `html:['ghost']` which matches ANY CSS class named 'ghost'. 15.8% firing rate on HE suggests overfires. Tighten to require 'powered by Ghost' or script-source marker.
